title: Claude Code drives real devices over MCP
description:
Connect Claude Code (or any MCP client) to VirtualPyTest's MCP server and your AI works on real devices. On the left is the live screen of a device; on the right, Claude Code in a terminal. Ask in plain words: which devices can you use, open YouTube's search results, go back home, what's on the screen, verify we're on home. Every tool call happens live on the device: it navigates through the interface's map, takes a screenshot and describes it, and runs the node's check.

Open source & free.
